sources.snippet: Overview chinese-wav2vec2-base is a self-supervised speech representation model pretrained on 10,000 hours of the WenetSpeech L subset, developed by TencentGameMate. The model uses the Wav2Vec2 architecture and extracts acoustic representations from raw audio without requiring labeled data during pretraining.
